subject: Subprocessor & network dataflow RFI — updated inventory and assurances
messages:
From: John Mallory <john.mallory@finservcorp.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: FinServ Security <security@finservcorp.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Updated subprocessor list + network ownership mapping request

Kimberly —

Thanks for taking this. Our procurement/security team is finalizing the vendor risk assessment for the upcoming deployment of Redwood in our payments flow. We need an updated subprocessor inventory and a clear mapping of which party/region is responsible for network egress, edge operators, and KV/store custody. Specifically, please provide:

- a current subprocessor CSV with company, role, hosting region(s), and contact
- a network dataflow diagram showing where customer data traverses (control plane vs data plane)
- assurances about any planned operator or cloud-provider changes in the next 12 months (esp. for us-east-1 workloads)
- expected notification window for any subprocessor changes and whether breaks in residency or additional subprocessors will trigger an amendment

I've attached our RFI template (RFI-template-FinServ.xlsx) to help map answers into our tracker. Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday 10/7 if you can provide the materials, and whether a short call is needed?

Best,
John Mallory
Senior Infosec Manager
FinServ Corp
attachments: RFI-template-FinServ.xlsx
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: John Mallory <john.mallory@finservcorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Updated subprocessor list + network ownership mapping request

John —

Appreciate the clear ask. We're assembling a concise package and should be able to deliver the CSV + diagram by Wednesday 10/7. Quick notes up front:

- We will provide a single CSV export (redwood_subprocessors_20261005.csv) listing subprocessors, primary role, region(s), contact, and last contractual update date.
- Attached is a simplified network_dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf mapping control-plane vs data-plane ownership and common egress paths for hosted vs dedicated deployments.
- We will flag any planned operator/region changes; current standing: no planned migrations for us-production clusters in the next 12 months. Any required changes would follow our 45-day notification policy for standard customers; for enterprise customers we can negotiate longer notice windows in contract addenda.

Karthik and Marcus are pulled in to confirm the roster details and provide the operator contact list and any contractual language we suggest for your review. If you'd prefer a short sync to walk through the diagram, I'm available Wed 10/7 09:30–11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20261005.csv, network_dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, John Mallory <john.mallory@finservcorp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Updated subprocessor list + network ownership mapping request

John, Kimberly —

Attaching operator_roster_20261005.csv (internal roster + primary contacts). Quick highlights for your inventory: 

- CloudNexus (compute): primary for hosted API; regions: us-east-1, us-west-2 (control plane in us-east-1, data plane multi-region). Contact: risk@cloudnexus.io.
- EdgeOps (edge operator): manages low-latency edge routing in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 (used for dedicated/edge customers).
- StorageCo (object store): multi-region S3-compatible storage; default us-west-2 for new tenants.

On the notification window: our standard customer T&Cs specify 45 days' notice for subprocessor additions or material changes. For regulated customers (like FinServ) we are open to a negotiated clause that requires 90 days' notice and an option to require an impact review call prior to the change. We can supply suggested contract language if you want to propose that to legal.

Also: SOC 2 artifacts are available via our secure portal; Neha, can you add the FinServ RFI access request so John can request specific evidence?

-Karthik
attachments: operator_roster_20261005.csv
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, John Mallory <john.mallory@finservcorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Updated subprocessor list + network ownership mapping request

John —

A few operational assurances from the platform/ops side: 

- We do not perform control-plane migration for production workloads without explicit customer agreement; any such activity would include a 90-day migration notice and an agreed rollback plan.
- For data residency, customer data for hosted deployments is pinned to the selected region by default; cross-region failover is opt-in and requires contractual consent.
- If you require contract language, we recommend adding a short clause: "Provider will notify Customer at least 90 days prior to any planned change to a subprocessor that materially affects data residency or introduces a new cross-border transfer; Provider will provide a technical impact assessment and remediation plan upon request."

I also added a link to our internal runbook for fallback playbooks (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-rfis) — happy to walk through the plan on the call.

-Marcus
From: John Mallory <john.mallory@finservcorp.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: FinServ Security <security@finservcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Updated subprocessor list + network ownership mapping request

Kimberly, Karthik, Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. We reviewed the CSVs and diagram; two quick clarifications before we close this item in our tracker:

1) For CloudNexus: can you confirm whether control-plane telemetry (logs/trace) for our tenant is retained in us-east-1 only or replicated to a secondary region for redundancy? If replicated, what's the retention policy and is it encrypted at rest using a customer-managed key option?
2) Can you confirm that the 90-day notification clause will be acceptable for the production payment stack (we'll flag as a compliance requirement)?

If you can confirm both items by EOD Monday 10/11, we should be able to mark the questionnaire complete. Also — please send the SOC 2 evidence access link or next steps so our security team can request the artifacts.

I'll plan to take the 10/7 sync notes offline since the attachments were sufficient; if anything changes we'll ask for the short follow-up call.

Regards,
John Mallory
Senior Infosec Manager
FinServ Corp
